event.description:
Hey everyone! We're running a Grand Archive Draft Day this Thursday! 🎉

Come along, crack some packs, build a deck and see what you can come up with!

We'll also have a special Nameless Champion Draft Day Playmat as part of the event.

Good chance to give draft a go, even if you haven't tried it before. See you Thursday! 😁
